note: Per-step means from block timing. Differences between schemes (~0.02 ms) are not resolvable against the block-to-block spread, and would not be expected to be: quantization here is simulated, so every ONNX graph stores float32 weights and has the same shape. A packed-integer kernel would be a different measurement.
